answer: New identities join only through a grove of three established sponsors, each locking 25 POA for 45 days as shared liability, then climb a three-tier summit of audited tasks, one per tier, each checked by a different sponsor. A second identity from the same grove costs each sponsor 50 POA and must redo all three tiers, a third 100 POA, so sponsor capital doubles with every fake. Auditors verify sponsor locks and tier records on-ledger, slash 30% of linked bonds for copied work, and award a jade seal only after 30 clean days.
